decision_rules.GALACTIC_STAR_HIGH_CONFIDENCE: Gaia parallax S/N >= 5 OR combined proper-motion significance >= 5 sigma
decision_rules.LIKELY_STAR_OR_COMPACT_SOURCE: Gaia counterpart exists but high-confidence astrometric star gate is not passed
decision_rules.OPTICAL_SOURCE_STAR_OR_GALAXY_UNRESOLVED: SDSS and Pan-STARRS counterpart within 2 arcsec, no Gaia counterpart within 2 arcsec
decision_rules.UNCLASSIFIED_CATALOG_SOURCE: none of the stronger rules pass
